name: Necromancer Ice Mastery adds 30% of Intellect to spell power (#657)
contract: Ice Mastery 560045 is the Necromancer's Rime level 20 passive (CharacterAdvancement 4436, ClassType 25 = class 23, Tab 60 Rime, RequiredLevel 20, no essence cost). Its client description reads 'Increases your spell power by $s3% of your Intellect.' Effect 2 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_SPELL_DAMAGE_OF_STAT_PERCENT (174) with MiscValue 126 (every magic school), MiscValueB 3 (Intellect) and BasePoints 29 + DieSides 1 = 30. Effects 0 (MOD_RATING_FROM_STAT, crit rating) and 1 (Ascension all-hit) have BasePoints -1 + DieSides 1 = 0, so they add nothing; the aura ToolTip's crit wording describes that zero-amount effect. Unit::SpellBaseDamageBonusDone adds CalculatePct(Intellect, 30) for every aura of type 174 whose school mask matches, so learning the passive must raise Shadow and Frost spell power by 30% of the current Intellect (integer truncation keeps the ratio within 0.28-0.305) and unlearning it must remove exactly that bonus.
